questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

How many languages can you speak?

options.text: How many languages can be spoken by you?
How many languages can be spoke by you?
How many languages are being spoken by you?
How many languages have been spoken by you?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'How many languages can be spoken by you?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The process of transformation as follows:
 
 
• In** 'active-passive' transformation** except for **(who and whom)** rest of the **Wh-family Pronouns **will remain **unchanged**. 
 
• Here, in the given question** 'How many languages'** will remain unchanged. 
 
• **'can speak'** will be changed into** 'can be spoken'.**
 
• Lastly, the conjunction** 'by' **will be added. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1. **

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__** *How many languages can be spoken by you?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question:
**Given below are four sentences that are jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order.**

A. They brought glory to themselves and victory to their country.

B. Peace also has its own victories.

C. But victory is not won only in war.

D. Great conquerors left an imprint on time.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'DACB'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• Here, in the given question **Part D** will be the first sentence because **Part D** is **an independent generalized statement. **
 
• **Part A** will be the next sentence because **Part D** tells us about the** 'Great conquerors' **and **Part A** further explains what **the Great conquerors bring. **
 
• **Part A** ends with *'The great conquerors bring victory to their country'* and** Part C **further explains it. 
 
• Lastly, **Part B** will be used because** Part C **and **Part B** are connected. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1. **

 ​

**Correct arrangement:__** *Great conquerors left an imprint on time. They brought glory to themselves and victory to their country. But victory is not won only in war. Peace also has its own victories.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

He said to his uncle, “I will meet you at the station tomorrow.”

options.text: He said to his uncle that he will meet you at the station tomorrow.
He told his uncle that he would meet him at the station the next day.
He told to his uncle that he would meet you at the station the next day.
He told his uncle that he will meet him at the station the next day.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'He told his uncle that he would meet him at the station the next day.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The process of transformation as follows:
 
 
• Here, in the given question** 'said to' **will be changed into** 'told' **because the **reporting** speech has an **object**. 
 
• The conjunction** 'that' **will be added and **comma** and inverted **commas** will be removed. 
 
• The pronoun** 'I'** will be changed into **'he' **because the first person **pronouns** are changed according to the **subject** of the **reporting** verb. 
 
• **'will meet'** will be changed into **'would meet'. **
 
• The second person pronoun **'you' **will be changed into** 'him' **because it is changed according to the **object** of the **reporting** verb. 
 
• Lastly, the **adverb** **'tomorrow' **will be changed into **'the next day'. **
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 2. **

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__** *He told his uncle that he would meet him at the station the next day.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Change in adverbs and determines in Direct To Indirect Speech.

**Correct Sentence:__** *The news **was broadcast** last evening. ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***
